question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The ship was facing very stronger current in the ocean.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Very stronger current"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of other options Option
 
 
• **Very stronger current **Here stronger is the comparative form of an adjective,**"Strong" **which is giving extra information about, "**Current"**

 
 
• **Uncountable nouns** are preceded by **Much. **Here Current is an Uncountable Noun.

 
 
• **Countable Nouns **nouns are followed by **Many**.
 
 
 
 
 
• ** was facing **is correct. Hence The ship is singular and followed by the singular verb "**was"**
 
• **The Ship **is correct in spelling.
 
• **In the ocean** is correct in spelling and meaning.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence will be," The ship was facing **much stronger** currents in the ocean.
